##Add Required Packages
```{r packages, include=FALSE}

#Packages that are required 
lapply(c( "fluxfinder", "readxl",
  "dplyr", "ggplot2", "ggpubr", "stringr",
  "purrr", "tidyverse", "here", "broom", "tibble",
  "googledrive", "googlesheets4", "data.table", 
  "matrixStats", "gridExtra", "grid", "tidyverse", "knitr"), 
  library, character.only = TRUE)

```

## Pull in Raw Datafiles
```{r, echo=FALSE}

#list files in raw data folder
L <- list.files(path = "Raw Data/", pattern = "data$", full.names = TRUE)
head(L)

#Read in the data 
alldat1 <- lapply(L, ffi_read_LI7810)

alldat <- data.table::rbindlist(alldat1, fill=TRUE)


```

## Read in metadata file and match to raw data
```{r}
#read in metadata file
md <- "Raw Data/COMPASS_Synoptic_LE_MACFlux_Metadata_2023.csv"
metadat <- read.csv(md)

#can remove any row that have NA's in the date column 
metadat <- metadat %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date))

head(metadat) 

#need to make a unique plot id that includes the date or an obs number
metadat$Plot <- paste0(metadat$Plot, "-", seq_len(nrow(metadat)))
metadat$Obs_length <- 90

head(metadat)
```

## Match metadata to raw data considering #SN 
```{r}

# looping the match function to separate data per Licor SN

instrumentos <- unique(alldat$SN)

alldat_final <- data.table::rbindlist(lista_resultados, fill = TRUE)

lista_resultados <- lapply(instrumentos, function(sn){

  message("Processando SN: ", sn)

  dat_i  <- alldat  %>% filter(SN == sn)
  meta_i <- metadat %>% filter(SN == sn)
  meta_i$metadat_row <- seq_len(nrow(meta_i))

  dat_i$metadat_row <- fluxfinder:::ffi_metadata_match(
    data_timestamps = dat_i$TIMESTAMP,
    start_dates     = meta_i$Date,
    start_times     = meta_i$Time_start,
    obs_lengths     = meta_i$Obs_length
  )
  meta_i$matched <- meta_i$metadat_row %in% dat_i$metadat_row
  meta_i_nomatched <- meta_i %>% filter(!matched)
  if(nrow(meta_i_nomatched) > 0){
    message("Plots sem match para ", sn, ": ", paste(meta_i_nomatched$Plot, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dat_i$Plot   <- meta_i$Plot[dat_i$metadat_row]
  dat_i$Volume <- meta_i$Volume[dat_i$metadat_row]
  dat_i$Temp   <- meta_i$Temp[dat_i$metadat_row]
  dat_i$Site   <- meta_i$Site[dat_i$metadat_row]
  dat_i <- dat_i %>% filter(!is.na(metadat_row))

  return(dat_i)
})



```

## Calculate fluxes 
```{r}

#changed "alldat" df to "alldat_final" to include data separated by SN
#change the units
alldat_final$CH4_nmol <- ffi_ppb_to_nmol(alldat_final$CH4, 
                                volume = alldat_final$Volume, # m3
                                temp = alldat_final$Temp)    # degrees C
#> Assuming atm = 101325 Pa
#> Using R = 8.31446261815324 m3 Pa K-1 mol-1

alldat_final$CH4_nmol_m2 <- alldat_final$CH4_nmol / 0.16

fluxes <- ffi_compute_fluxes(alldat_final, 
                             group_column = "Plot", 
                             time_column = "TIMESTAMP", 
                             gas_column = "CH4_nmol_m2", 
                             dead_band = 10)
head(fluxes)

#take a look at the fluxes we calculated with R2 
ggplot(fluxes, aes(Plot, lin_flux.estimate, color = lin_r.squared)) +
  geom_point(size=4) + theme_classic() + 
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lin_flux.estimate- lin_flux.std.error,
                   ymax = lin_flux.estimate+ lin_flux.std.error)) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colours = c("darkred",  "red", "white","lightblue", "darkblue"),
                        values = c(0, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 1)) +
  ylab("CH4 flux (nmol/m2/s)")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

#sort fluxes by R2 
fluxes_good <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_r.squared >= .90, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))
fluxes_weird <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_r.squared < .90, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))

#find fluxes that represent the first and fourth quartile of the data 
low <- quantile(fluxes$lin_flux.estimate, 0.05) 
high <- quantile(fluxes$lin_flux.estimate, 0.95) 

fluxes_low <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_flux.estimate <= low, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))
fluxes_high <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_flux.estimate >= high, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))

tails <- rbind(fluxes_low, fluxes_high)

#saving files processed by Licor SN to avoid problems with duplicated TIMESTAMP

```
